title: The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties
assumptions: The abelian variety is defined over the complex numbers and has complex multiplication (CM).
Only rational Hodge classes are considered; integral Hodge classes are outside the quoted claim.
Algebraic cycle classes are taken with rational coefficients.
conclusion: Every rational Hodge class on a complex CM abelian variety is a rational linear combination of algebraic cycle classes, in every dimension and codimension.

scopeDiff.paperStatement: Proves the rational Hodge conjecture for every complex CM abelian variety, in every dimension and codimension. Through Milne's theorems, this also gives the Tate conjecture for all abelian varieties over finite fields and the Hodge standard conjecture for abelian varieties in every characteristic.

glossary.definition: A property of an abelian variety: its endomorphism algebra contains a number field of degree twice the variety's dimension.
A rational cohomology class of Hodge type (p,p) on a smooth projective complex variety.
The cohomology class of a formal rational linear combination of algebraic subvarieties.
A conjecture relating algebraic cycles over a finite field to Galois-invariant cohomology classes.
